title: Plan FPVBuddy's data backup against NERV's
goal: The backup or replication of FPVBuddy's server data is chosen before any owner data arrives
acceptance: From where F-009-T01 puts the server and its data, the record compares FPVBuddy's plan with NERV's store (a nightly integrity-checked snapshot, 7 kept, and a replicated standby store on a second machine, NERV-01 to NERV-02): a matching or better plan, or the exact gap (what can be lost, for how long) for the owner to accept
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Owner data, export files and ID maps never enter Git

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: a read of NERV's snapshot and standby docs and the F-009-T01 choice, then a short write-up. Not a measurement.
